title: Canonicalize persistent desktop provenance
outcome: Persistent desktop pilot integration records canonically identify exactly one top-level ticket task, distinguish controller-issued role runs, and use privacy-safe stable worktree aliases with deterministic sharing semantics.
scope: Add canonically discovered workflow tests in a bounded rework-safe PILOT-006 test directory.
Define one opaque ticket-task identity, controller-issued role runs, stable opaque worktree aliases, privacy exclusions, and deterministic sequential/concurrent sharing rules.
Persist candidate-bound clean coverage evidence before review.
nonGoals: Change validator behavior, ticket schemas, Deno task definitions, agent configuration, application behavior, architecture, or database schema.
Modify, depend on, or claim integration of blocked PILOT-004 or PILOT-005 work.
Persist absolute or repository-relative filesystem paths, personal or client identifiers, credentials, secrets, or sensitive local topology.
Claim support for ephemeral CLI multi-agent orchestration.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The delivery contract contains exactly once a contiguous persistent-pilot block defining exactly one opaque ticketTaskId, mutually distinct controller-issued role identities, exactly one stable opaque worktreeRef per role execution, same-worktree/same-reference and distinct-worktree/distinct-reference invariants, privacy exclusions for every persisted identity, and explicit sequential, concurrent-writer, and read-only-reviewer sharing rules; both canonical workflow tasks discover the enforcing test directory.
acceptanceCriteria.redProof: deno test --allow-read=deno.json,docs/development/autonomous-delivery.md tools/workflows/pilot006/persistent_desktop_provenance_test.ts fails solely because the exact provenance block is absent while task-discovery assertions pass.

risks: Persisted identifiers or worktree references could disclose personal, client, credential, secret, or local-topology information.
Unstable or reused aliases could make shared and isolated execution topologies indistinguishable.
A claimed clean-candidate coverage gate could be unverifiable unless its command, candidate revision, count, exit, and thresholds are stored in ticket evidence.
